nodes.text: As of January 2, 2025, there are reports of a significant outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV) in China. The virus is spreading rapidly, causing flu-like and COVID-19-like symptoms, and has led to crowded hospitals and overwhelmed healthcare facilities.
